semantic.implementation: Separate rod-and-panel RGBA image layer on left-window plane. Mount rodEndpoints on fixed window anchors, uniformly scale all models by rod span so short model stays short. Architecture/window/outdoors/plant are separate layers. Transparent opening reveals window. Check curtain/plant alpha intersections; no baked caption or control.
semantic.notes: Scale whole room and anchored children together responsively. Parent owns app implementation; static composites still required.
